City of Encinitas
AMENDED Special Joint City Council & Commission for the Arts Meeting 4:00 p.m. (Updated Recommended Action)
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 12, 2025 -
04:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
City Council: Mayor Ehlers, Deputy Mayor Lyndes, Council Members O'Hara, San Antonio, and Shaffer
Commission for the Arts: Chair Fox, Vice Chair Marakovits, Commissioners Campbell, Fator, Hebert, Kadakia and Roemer
AGENDA ITEMS
1.
Pacific View Arts Center report on first year of operations. Environmental Considerations: The actions being considered by the City Council are exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because they are not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The actions involve organizational or administrative activities of government that will not result in a direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Arts Division Manager Murphy
Receive and discuss the Pacific View Arts Center report and consider potential direction from the City Council.
2025-11-12 Item 01 Joint Meeting City & Commission for the Arts - Pacific View Arts Center AMENDED
2025-11-12 Item 01 Joint Meeting City & Commission for the Arts - Pacific View Arts Center - Presentation
2025-11-12 Item 01 Joint Meeting City & Commission for the Arts - Pacific View Arts Center - Public Comments
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
